lines.zh: 我头顶那朵花，一颠一颠
lines.en: The bloom on my head bobs as I walk.
I'm round and walk slowly.
A few small ones follow behind.

lines.zh: 我的脚是绿的，踩过叶就碎
lines.en: My green feet crush leaves as they pass.

lines.zh: 我朝地里有东西的地方走
lines.en: I walk toward where things grow.

lines.zh: 一块地被我看过，就记住了
lines.en: Once I look at a plot, I remember it.
I eat as I walk, not much.
When I lower my head, the flower tips sideways.

lines.zh: 草丛很高，我刚好露出花
lines.en: The grass is tall; only my flower shows.
I circle the field once.

lines.zh: 身上是绿黄的，像熟了的果子
lines.en: Green and yellow, like ripening fruit.
I don't run; it looks awful.
I stand and the flower still sways.
I'm looking at the soil in the field.
I chew, slowly.
This field is mine to tend.
The leaves on me are drooping.
My head is heavy and my feet light.
I count what's sprouted.
I can only talk about the field.

lines.zh: 太阳好的时候我站得更久
lines.en: On sunny days I stand longer.
My flower has been open a while.
There are bugs on my bloom.
I turn my head slowly.
Is there enough water in the field?
I don't like being driven off.
You're standing in my field.
Don't pick the bloom on my head.

lines.zh: 我看起来笨，其实记得清
lines.en: I look clumsy, but I remember well.

lines.zh: 你要干什么，别踩我的地
lines.en: What do you want? Don't tread my soil.
What I planted isn't for trampling.
I'm round, but not soft.
You're looking at my flower.
I'm here all day.
Step out and I'll pretend I didn't see.
I'm not fierce, but I do charge.
If you want to come in, ask me first.
I've tended this field a long while.
Your foot is over my sprouts.

lines.zh: 你的影子压在我的苗上
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my sprouts.
I don't shout; I just stand in the way.
A few leaves came off.
I swayed a long time before settling.
My flower flopped to one side.
I don't cry out; I only retreat.
I've churned the soil badly.
My chest heaves.
I've crushed things in the field.
Don't charge again.
What I want is garden greens.
Are those seeds in your hand?
This can be planted.
Put it on the ground; I'll eat it myself.
Apart from leaves, I don't open my beak.
This one's too old.
The leaf on top is tenderest.
One more small handful.
Let me taste it.
Stand still.
Is this enough to plant a plot?
I'm not picky; if it grows, fine.
You hit me and I rocked three times.
I'm round; a hit makes me roll.
That knocked leaves off me.
You back off and I right myself.
I hit heavily.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土都飞了
lines.en: We collided and soil flew.
Don't step on my roots.
Move, I'm going to the far field.
I shift aside to let you cross the field.
There's only one like me in this field.
The flower on my head is at its best.
We rely on pollen.
I'm not clear on that.
I'm in the soil all day.
Don't ask about that.
The little ones follow me.
Never mind; I've fields to water.
Quiet, I'm listening to the soil.
I take it slowly.
My beak takes it up.
This clod of soil is just right.
I'm slow at picking things up.
What falls, I gather.
This isn't a seed.
I tuck it under my flower.
These belong to the field.
You take it; I'm not short.
Something's moving there.
That isn't from the field.
I raise my head to see better.
It's stepped on my soil.
I know this smell.
Close enough to throw a rock.
It's coming my way.

lines.zh: 它踩着我的苗，我盯住了
lines.en: It's on my sprouts; I've got it.
That's the field I planted.
Just that one.
It's standing on my boundary.
It stepped on my soil; now.

lines.zh: 我这团圆身子，慢慢滚近。
lines.en: This round body of mine rolls slowly closer.
It withdraws; I hold the field.
I pack the soil under me.
Its steps come nearer.
The rock hits by its feet.
Two steps more.
It's hiding past the trunk.
A tree won't stop a rock.
It's still in my field.
All of this is mine.
I pick a stone up.
One more throw.

lines.zh: 石头滑过去打在它腿上
lines.en: A gliding rock strikes its leg.
That was heavy.
It was pushed back a step.
I peck with my beak.
My flower sweeps its face.
It retreated; I stand back in the field.
That didn't land right.
I push it to the field's edge.
I kick up soil.
It's standing still.
I charge again.
I rose at the field's edge.
The flower on my head opened first.
The soil here is decent.
I shake the mud out of my feathers.
The egg opened and I landed.
I surveyed the field first.
No kin of mine nearby.
The bloom isn't fully open yet.
Leaves crunch under my feet.
I've started work.
Fire singed the leaves and a patch went black.

lines.zh: 水里我浮起来，沉不下去
lines.en: I float in water; can't sink.
The blast rolled me to the field's edge.

lines.zh: 一根东西扎在我身上，像根刺
lines.en: Something stuck in me like a thorn.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的花合上了
lines.en: The spell hit and my flower closed.
Hungry, my green fades.

lines.zh: 雷打在田里，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning struck the field and I went numb.
No soil in the void; I'm panicking.
